title: Factorial base-head reproduction of late destination creation

timing.note: UTC timestamps immediately before and after the single clean-checkout deterministic run were identical to the second.

deviations: GPT Pro Session B reported the three creation-time outcomes before this local design freeze.

A local inline smoke run reproduced the reported pattern on both exact revisions before this machine record was written. The frozen runner is therefore reproducibility hardening under complete outcome access, not an independent or confirmatory replication.
The current PR 55 documentation head is 2bda2ff38ea79dd0901f6329490d2f9940690261; its executable canonical code is unchanged from f26e148602099d7be01c2759be394c6ee4ff6204.

A post-result Daybreak model-assisted manual review independently regenerated the frozen result but found that the then-current CI did not execute both pinned revisions and that the reusable summarizer coerced non-Boolean values with bool(). Post-result hardening at 3a75243338b5df2e60d638005c6dc486ad7e11bd added exact two-checkout artifact reproduction and fail-closed Boolean validation without changing the frozen c8a3f15 runner or result bytes.

dataset.name: Synthetic late-destination temporal factorial
dataset.split: all 2 source revisions x 3 destination creation times x 3 implementations

models.reasoning_effort: Pro UI; underlying model version and token usage not exposed
models.claim_boundary: complete prior outcome access disclosed as a deviation, not an independent judge
model-assisted manual review, not human peer review

independent_variables: destination mind creation system time: 5, 6, or 7
dependent_variables: Gold, Generic, and Typed Boolean AVAILABLE answer in every cell
paired base/head answer differences over nine implementation-by-time cells
controls.stopping_rule: After the runner is committed, execute it once from clean exact main and PR 55 checkouts; emit exactly 18 Boolean outputs and nine paired revision comparisons; do not alter the event sequence or add cells after observing output.

results.primary_outcome: paired base/head Boolean difference count over 9 matched implementation-by-time cells
secondary_outcomes: within-revision Gold/Generic/Typed agreement by creation-time stratum
results.interpretation: PR 55 changes 0/9 paired implementation-by-time answers in this frozen factorial. The late-destination Gold/Generic false versus Typed true divergence is present on exact main and PR 55, so it is not introduced or repaired by PR 55. The paired base/head denominator is nine; eighteen is the total raw Boolean-output denominator across both revisions.

cost.note: One local deterministic run from three clean exact checkouts plus a later Daybreak model-assisted manual review and zero-cost deterministic CI hardening; no metered hosted model or official scorer call. Subscription token usage was not exposed or dollar-attributed.

artifacts.clean_checkouts: runner, main, and PR 55 git status were all empty after execution
artifacts.post_result_reproducibility_hardening: At 3a75243 the current summarizer rejects non-Boolean values and CI invokes tools/check_late_destination_factorial_reproduction.py, which runs frozen runner c8a3f15 against exact main and PR 55 checkouts and byte-compares all three committed artifacts. This is reproducibility hardening, not a second experiment.

daybreak_followup_review.boundary: model-assisted manual review, not human peer review or new outcome evidence

result_addendum: A Daybreak high manual follow-up at exact head 93baef0 accepted the N1 and N2 closures with no remaining blocking or non-blocking finding. It independently reran the exact frozen reproduction at 18/18 raw outputs, 0/9 paired differences, and 3/3 artifact matches; a broader mutation harness rejected representative non-Boolean values 28/28 and preserved genuine False/True 2/2. This validates post-result reproducibility hardening only and does not create a second experiment or human peer review.
claim_boundary: Prior-access development reproduction of one synthetic temporal event family. It can distinguish whether PR 55 changes these nine matched outputs and characterize this exact reference-before-creation mechanism; it cannot estimate natural prevalence, establish confirmatory causality, or replace the PR 56 invalid-input contract.
